entity: Vermont private-sale background checks in 2022, last of the 10 law states
why: WCAX gives Vermont private-sale check counts, 48 in 2017 and about 90 in 2018, but a different window and framed as a post-law spike, so the numbers can't line up with our 2022 last-of-10 ranking. The compliance study covers Washington and Colorado, not Vermont's rank.
